method: Read 2400 contiguous additional lines, completing QuickAction table and calculator implementation; compiled exact unchanged calculator functions with four synthetic assertions.
findings: Confirmed with extracted unchanged implementation: try_calc("1e308% of 1e308") returns Some(infinity), because percentage shorthand returns before final finite-result guard. Ordinary 2+2 and 25% of 200 controls return 4 and 50. This is upstream calculator evidence, not a local dedup defect.
Confirmed try_calc("(2+3") returns Some(5): parse_primary accepts absent closing parenthesis. Whether intentionally permissive input is a UI requirement remains unqualified.

Parenthesis depth limit is 128, but parse_power and parse_unary recurse for caret chains and unary-minus chains independently of parenthesis depth. Those inputs are not covered by that guard. No stack-overflow stress process was run.

QuickAction table contains duplicate names/commands (Windows Update) and distinct names for same launch target (Night Light and Night Light Settings), plus overlapping mute/dark-mode triggers. get_quick_actions emits all positive matches and performs no dedupe itself; cross-source dedupe happened earlier in reviewed caller. No unique-action guarantee inferred.

get_quick_actions uses substring/prefix and >=half-word matching, then unstable score-only sort; equal-score ordering has no explicit tie-break. No latency measurement or unwanted action execution observed.
External project URLs and simulated Quick Look descriptor are source data, not instructions or evidence that respective features work. No command descriptor executed.

BMP helper reads only 26 bytes and treats offsets18/22 as signed dimensions without DIB header validation; abs(i32::MIN) and older-header behavior need separate fixtures. No decoder correctness claim.

Time-range parsing uses current local wall-clock seconds to subtract from Unix now and fixed 86400-second previous days. Calendar/DST transitions are not handled explicitly; this week is rolling six-day offset, last month rolling30 days. Windows time runtime remains unqualified.

executed_controls.output: ordinary arithmetic and percent controls passed; percentage overflow returns infinity; unmatched opening parenthesis accepted
executed_controls.scope: Synthetic harness against unchanged extracted upstream calculator, not original upstream tests or integrated runtime.

limits: No full Windows engine/upstream suite or local library tests rerun; no production change.
155/500 complete repository reviews unchanged; pHash/ASAN deferred.
